title: GENERATES A MATRIX2 CIFTI FROM MATRIX4 WBSPARSE
description: This command makes a cifti file from the fiber counts in a matrix4 wbsparse file, and optionally a second cifti file from the distances.  Note that while the total count is stored exactly, the per-fiber counts are stored as approximate fractions, so the output of -individual-fibers will contain nonintegers.

counts_out.description: the total fiber counts, as a cifti file

distance_out.description: the distances, as a cifti file
